query: "Studies on vouchers to improve fruit affordability and consumption in Nigeria and Vietnam, focusing on RCTs assessing the impact of targeted vouchers on peri-urban and urban households, including measurement methods, operational logistics, data analysis, and policy implications in nutrition and social sciences."

response.query: Studies on vouchers to improve fruit affordability and consumption in Nigeria and Vietnam, focusing on RCTs assessing the impact of targeted vouchers on peri-urban and urban households, including measurement methods, operational logistics, data analysis, and policy implications in nutrition and social sciences.
response.answer: Randomized controlled trials in Nigeria and Vietnam showed vouchers increased fruit affordability and consumption in peri-urban and urban households. Data analysis focused on consumption changes and logistics included voucher distribution methods. Policy implications suggest vouchers can improve nutrition in low-income areas.
